text:
Nina Lopez: FYI 10 10 — Cerulean Systems asked to split next Tuesday's enablement: 20m exec overview for renewal sponsors, then a hands-on lab. Maya is on PTO so need to reassign roles.
Kai Becker: I can take the exec overview (20m) and highlight ROI metrics.
Rina Das: I'll run the hands-on lab but need someone for the migration-checklist + blockers (15m).
Tom O'Neill: I can own migration checklist + live triage. Will also capture any renewal-risk flags.
Nina Lopez: Proposed timeline:
```
10:00-10:20am PT  Exec overview & success metrics (Kai)
10:20-10:35am PT  Migration checklist + blockers (Tom)
10:35-11:20am PT  Hands-on lab + breakouts (Rina)
11:20-11:30am PT  Wrap, feedback capture, next steps (All)
```
Rina Das: Can we shift start to 9:45am PT to accommodate EMEA engineers joining? 9:45 start gives them a better overlap.
Kai Becker: 9:45 works for me. I'll shorten demo to 18m and leave 2m for quick asks.
Tom O'Neill: fine. I'll prepare a blocker triage template and tag owners in notes.
Nina Lopez: Action items: Kai add pre-read slide + recording opt-in; Tom prepare migration checklist and renewal-risk flags; Rina post lab VM and troubleshooting FAQ 24h prior. I'll update calendar and set reminders.
OnboardingBot: Cerulean enablement updated by Nina Lopez. 27 RSVPs. Recording enabled.
Kai Becker: Pre-read uploaded: https://internal.ceru/pre-read (internal).
Rina Das: Lab VM link will be posted by EOD tomorrow.
Tom O'Neill: I'll synthesize blockers into the renewal tracker post-session.
Nina Lopez: Excellent. React :white_check_mark: when your items are done and I'll lock the invite. Thanks team.
